title: Study Assessing the Safety and Efficacy of ABT-263 in Subjects With B-cell Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL) Who Have Failed at Least One Prior Fludarabine-containing Regimen

sections.abstract: This is a Phase 2b, open-label, multicenter, global study assessing the safety and efficacy of ABT-263 in subjects with B-cell CLL who have failed at least one prior fludarabine-containing regimen.
